build_grammar_from_json_schema: build a GBNF grammar from a JSON schema file for use with llama-cli
run_schema_converter_cli: run the json_schema_to_grammar CLI tool to convert a JSON schema into a GBNF grammar
generate_grammar_with_refs: generate a GBNF grammar that resolves $ref fields and fetches remote schemas via --allow-fetch
create_grammar_with_custom_prop_order: create a GBNF grammar with custom property ordering using --prop-order
generate_grammar_with_pattern: generate a GBNF grammar from a JSON schema containing regex patterns with --dotall and --raw-pattern
